HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cake Making and Decoration? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cake Making and Decoration.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cake Making and Decoration.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cake Making and Decoration.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cake Making and Decoration.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Planning Family Meals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Meal Service and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Food Preservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cake Making and Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.

2. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

3. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

7. D — Ice melting to water

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cake Making and Decoration.

9. B — 100 °C

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
